topArticle.summary: ベルギーで発生した大規模火災が国境を越える恐れがあり、ドイツのモンシャウ住民が避難。今のところドイツへの延焼は阻止されている。

topArticle.title: Hundreds flee as Belgium battles wildfire at German border
topArticle.description: A rapidly spreading wildfire has scorched about 2,700 hectares in the High Fens nature reserve near Belgium's border with Germany. Some homes in the German town of Monschau were evacuated overnight as a precaution.

topArticle.title: Italy: Thieves steal key Renaissance paintings in Sicily
topArticle.description: Four Renaissance paintings by Antonello da Messina were stolen from his Sicilian hometown on Saturday after surviving earthquakes and centuries of history. Crooks took them while locals celebrated a religious holiday.
topArticle.titleJa: イタリア：シチリアでルネサンス絵画が盗まれる
topArticle.summary: イタリアのシチリア島で、アントネッロ・ダ・メッシーナのルネサンス絵画4点が盗難に遭った。これらの絵画は地震や数世紀の歴史を乗り越えてきた。

topArticle.title: Zimbabwe boat accident death toll hits 68 as 22 more bodies recovered
topArticle.description:
Eighteen children among the people killed after ferry capsized on Lake Kariba
Twenty-two more bodies have been recovered after a boat accident in Zimbabwe, taking the death toll to 68, police said on Saturday.
The ferry capsized on Tuesday on Lake Kariba, on the border with Zambia. An investigation has suggested it was overloaded when it turned over during heavy winds.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ジンバブエのボート事故、さらに22人の遺体が発見され死者68人に
topArticle.summary: ジンバブエのカリバ湖で発生したボート転覆事故の死者数が68人に達した。過積載と強風が原因とみられ、18人の子供も犠牲になった。

topArticle.title: Moroccan police arrest more than 100 people attempting to enter Ceuta
topArticle.description:
Border security tightened after social media posts call for another mass crossing into Spain’s north African territory
Moroccan police have arrested 111 people as they tried to enter Spain’s north African territory of Ceuta, amid ⁠tightened security on both sides after social media posts ​called for another mass crossing.
The attempted crossing on Saturday came two weeks after more than 72,000 migrants surged into Ceuta, causing tensions within the EU and prompting anti-immigration rhetoric among far-right parties worldwide. At least 96 people died trying to ⁠reach European soil.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: モロッコ警察、セウタへの入国を試みた100人以上を逮捕
topArticle.summary: モロッコ警察は、スペイン領セウタへの大規模な越境を試みた111人を逮捕。ソーシャルメディアの呼びかけを受けて国境警備が強化された。

topArticle.title: American missionary kidnapped in Niger freed after nine months
topArticle.description:
Kevin Rideout, who was abducted by unknown assailants in Niamey, said to be in good health and in care of US officials
An American missionary who was kidnapped in Niger in October has been released, his organisation has said.
Serving in Mission International said Kevin Rideout “is in good health in the care of US officials” and would soon be reunited with his extended family.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ニジェールで誘拐されたアメリカ人宣教師、9ヶ月ぶりに解放
topArticle.summary: ニジェールで昨年10月に誘拐されたアメリカ人宣教師ケビン・ライドアウト氏が解放された。米国当局の保護下にあり、健康状態は良好という。

topArticle.title: Brazil’s Lula launches historic fourth term bid – but son of jailed Bolsonaro stands in his way
topArticle.description:
President, 80, vows to keep far-right from power as Flávio Bolsonaro tells supporters he will ‘fight this system’
Brazil’s leftwing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has launched his campaign for a historic fourth term and vowed that as long as he lived he would not allow the “shameless” right to return to power.
Addressing a sea of supporters in São Bernardo do Campo, the industrial city where his political career began nearly half a century ago, the 80-year-old politician reminded voters of the chaos and violence that unfolded during the 2018-22 presidency of his far-right predecessor, Jair Bolsonaro, whose son Flávio Bolsonaro will face Lula in October’s presidential election.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ブラジルのルーラ大統領が歴史的な4期目出馬へ、対抗馬はボルソナーロ前大統領の息子
topArticle.summary: ブラジルのルーラ大統領が史上4期目を目指す選挙戦を開始。極右勢力の排除を誓い、ボルソナーロ前大統領の息子と対決する。

topArticle.title: Canadian plasma clinics pause collections after deaths of two donors
topArticle.description:
Grifols, which runs private chain of clinics, to temporarily stop taking donations after new government investigation
A chain of private plasma donation clinics in Canada has said it is pausing collections after the deaths of two donors and a new government investigation into potential unsafe practices.
Grifols, a Spanish healthcare company which runs 17 clinics in Canada and is the country’s only private clinic for plasma donation, said it informed Health Canada of its decision to temporarily pause collections on Wednesday.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: カナダの血漿献血クリニック、ドナー2人の死亡を受けて採集を一時停止
topArticle.summary: カナダの民間血漿献血クリニックが、ドナー2人の死亡と政府の調査を受け、献血採集を一時停止すると発表した。

topArticle.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’

topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震から1ヶ月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラ地震から1ヶ月、ラ・グアイラでは数千人の親族が劣悪な状況と不十分な支援の中、倒壊した建物の傍に留まり、行方不明の家族の捜索を続けている。

topArticle.title: Former Mexican governor charged in case of 43 students who vanished in 2014
topArticle.description:
Ángel Aguirre indicted in case that rocked Mexico and became symbol of its brutal cartel violence
The former governor of Guerrero state in Mexico has been formally charged over his alleged involvement in the disappearance of 43 students in 2014, a case that has become a symbol of the country’s brutal cartel violence and government impunity.
Ángel Aguirre, who was arrested last week, is accused of forced disappearance and obstruction of justice for ordering the destruction of surveillance tapes that may have shed light on what happened to the students from the Ayotzinapa teacher training college on the night of 26 September 2014.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: メキシコ元州知事、2014年に行方不明となった43人の学生事件で起訴される
topArticle.summary: メキシコのゲレロ州元知事が、2014年に失踪した43人の学生の事件に関連して正式に起訴された。この事件は、同国のカルテル暴力と政府の不処罰の象徴となっている。

topArticle.title: Presidential pardon for French alleged spy accused of plotting Mali coup

topArticle.title: Chadian environmental activist Hindou Oumarou: ‘AI governance must respect Indigenous peoples’

topArticle.summary: チャドの環境活動家は、AIの拡大が環境、水、生物多様性、先住民の権利に与える影響を懸念し、AIガバナンスにおける先住民尊重を訴えている。

topArticle.title: Whose conservation, whose development? The Maasai struggle over land in northern Tanzania

topArticle.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
topArticle.description: The Cernavodă plant, which produces 20% of Romania's electricity, is not expected to be restarted within the next 10 days.
topArticle.titleJa: 熱波によるドナウ川の水位大幅低下を受け、ルーマニアが唯一の原発を停止
topArticle.summary: ルーマニアは熱波によるドナウ川の水位低下を受け、唯一の原発を停止。電力の20%を賄う同施設は、10日以内に再稼働しない見通し。

topArticle.title: 70 years on, Argentine court declares ‘Operation Massacre’ a crime against humanity
topArticle.description: The victims’ families testified in court for the first time: "We want justice served. Even though their killers are no longer here, I want the truth known.”
topArticle.titleJa: 70年を経て、アルゼンチン裁判所が「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と宣言
topArticle.summary: 70年前の「虐殺作戦」が人道に対する罪と認定され、アルゼンチン裁判所で被害者家族が初めて証言。「正義と真実を知りたい」と語る。

topArticle.title: The Argentine who wishes he could play for Wales
topArticle.description: Proud of his Welsh roots, Chile-based Argentine defender Jeremias James hopes for a rule change to help his international ambitions.
topArticle.titleJa: ウェールズ代表入りを願うアルゼンチン人選手
topArticle.summary: ウェールズのルーツを持つチリ在住のアルゼンチン人ディフェンダー、ヘレミアス・ジェームズが、国際的な出場資格変更を望んでいます。

topArticle.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
topArticle.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
topArticle.titleJa: 市民権を武器化する：ニカラグアでの反体制派の沈黙
topArticle.summary: ニカラグアで、反体制派の市民権剥奪を正当化する権威主義的な言説を検証。市民権を政治的武器として利用する深刻な人権侵害の問題。

topArticle.title: Singapore police investigate assault on elderly man who patted child's head
topArticle.description: A man believed to be the father of the young girl allegedly threw the 73-year-old to the ground.
topArticle.titleJa: シンガポール警察、子供の頭をなでた高齢男性への暴行事件を捜査
topArticle.summary: シンガポールで、子供の頭をなでた73歳の高齢男性が、父親とされる人物に投げ倒された事件について警察が捜査している。

topArticle.title: Australian state to launch gun buyback after Bondi Beach attack
topArticle.description: New South Wales, where the attack took place, will offer gun owners cash to give up their firearms.
topArticle.titleJa: オーストラリアの州、ボンダイビーチ襲撃事件後に銃器買い戻し制度を開始へ
topArticle.summary: ボンダイビーチでの襲撃事件を受け、オーストラリアのニューサウスウェールズ州が銃器所有者に対し、銃器放棄と引き換えに現金を支給する買い戻し制度を導入する。

topArticle.title: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
topArticle.description: A father and his two young sons spent a night adrift before being rescued off the coast of the island of Koh Samui.
topArticle.titleJa: タイでジェットスキー転覆後、家族が16時間海上を漂流
topArticle.summary: タイのサムイ島沖でジェットスキーが転覆し、父親と幼い2人の息子が16時間海を漂流した後、無事に救助された。

topArticle.title: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
topArticle.description: Women across the country speak of public floggings, losing their jobs, and barriers to healthcare that endanger lives.
topArticle.titleJa: アフガニスタンの女性たち、タリバン支配5年で生活が一変したとBBCに語る
topArticle.summary: タリバン支配から5年が経過し、アフガニスタンの女性たちが公衆でのむち打ち、失業、命を危険にさらす医療への障壁など、生活が一変した状況をBBCに語った。

topArticle.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate
topArticle.description: On 5 August 2026, the United Kingdom notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day, a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate (PET).
topArticle.titleJa: 英国がポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: 英国は2026年8月5日、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート（PET）の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したとWTOに通報した。

topArticle.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
topArticle.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
topArticle.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVなどの車両措置に関する報告書を発行
topArticle.summary: WTOは7月28日、中国が提起した「トルコ—電気自動車およびその他の中国製車両に関する措置」に関するパネル報告書を配布した。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、開発途上国と後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上に3万ユーロを供与
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは2026年、開発途上国や後発開発途上国の政府職員向け貿易研修プログラム支援のため、WTOグローバル信託基金に3万ユーロを拠出する。

topArticle.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
topArticle.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
topArticle.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年までのWTO加盟目標を再確認し、加盟国に継続的な関与に感謝
topArticle.summary: ウズベキスタンは、7月27日・28日の会合で2026年までのWTO加盟プロセス完了への決意を再確認し、加盟国に継続的な関与への感謝を表明した。
